planning_notes: The request for 5 targets is fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the 9 available. To ensure non-redundancy and high quality at a MEDIUM difficulty, each target is assigned a unique pedagogical facet. This ensures that while the concepts are related (neural network training), the assessment angles (mechanism, rationale, code, prediction, error) are distinct, covering a broad range of cognitive skills from understanding to application and analysis.
